metadata.chapter_subtitle: From litterfall to soil organic matter — the slow carbon cycle

inventory.summary: The decomposition chapter already had a strong explanatory arc, but it needed clearer onboarding so readers could orient themselves to pools, rates, and climate controls before the equations accumulated.
issues: The chapter lacked the now-standard learner-facing opening scaffold.
The relationship between inputs, pool transfers, and decay benefits from being framed before formal notation begins.
The topic-library environmental sequence needed consistency in how specialist chapters announce prerequisites.

rewrite.summary: Added clearer onboarding and preserved the three-pool decomposition model and steady-state reasoning.
editor_notes: Added a Before You Start section.
Used the setup block to foreground first-order decay and climate controls.
Left the multi-pool derivation intact because it was already clear.

qa_review.summary: The chapter now enters the soil-carbon model more gently while preserving accurate multi-pool dynamics and steady-state calculations.

repair.summary: The repair focused on conceptual pacing and chapter-entry support rather than on changing the core model.
actions_taken: Added a Before You Start section.
Clarified the input-versus-decay logic before the equations.
Preserved the existing multi-pool and steady-state treatment.

design_review.summary: The chapter's visual and worked-example support is already strong, and the revised opening improves how those supports are interpreted.
improvements_made: Retained the chapter's strong pool-based explanatory structure.
Improved interpretive support around the role of temperature and moisture.
